## Constants

- `VoiceStyle` — DialogueSystem — Dynamic narrative template system. Pipeline: event → intent → template → mood → voice layer → relationship tone → final line NPC speech uses templates, not generative AI. The voice layer changes sentence length, glue words, confidence, politeness, swearing, emotional intensity.
